title: Chapter 7 Statistical Appendix: Fiscal System and Public Sector
introduction: This appendix uses existing archived international fiscal series to show level and trend. IMF general-government and World Bank central-government measures are kept separate. Values are descriptive evidence and do not replace national budget documents or establish conflict-related fiscal flows.

required_coverage.rationale: The reproducible IMF archive supports revenue, fiscal balance and gross debt; expenditure remains unresolved because its raw payload is unavailable.
Central-government revenue, tax effort, expense and interest burden provide a separate historical coverage layer.

categories.title: General-Government Fiscal Envelope
categories.introduction: IMF general-government series show the broad fiscal envelope but retain estimate/projection and coverage limitations.

indicators.title: General government revenue
indicators.question: How has broad public revenue changed relative to GDP?
indicators.subtitle_note: IMF DataMapper; general-government coverage; 2024 is latest archived observation and estimate status is not preserved

indicators.title: General government fiscal balance
indicators.question: Has the broad fiscal balance moved toward or away from borrowing pressure?
indicators.subtitle_note: IMF DataMapper; negative values indicate net borrowing; 2024 is latest archived observation

indicators.title: General government gross debt
indicators.question: How has the broad public-debt burden changed?
indicators.subtitle_note: IMF DataMapper; gross debt as percent of GDP; 2024 is latest archived observation

categories.title: Central-Government Fiscal Indicators
categories.introduction: World Bank central-government indicators provide a separate historical layer and end in 2019 in the archived package.

indicators.title: Central-government revenue excluding grants
indicators.question: How broad was central-government revenue excluding grants in the historical series?
indicators.subtitle_note: World Bank WDI; central-government coverage; latest archived observation 2019

indicators.title: Tax revenue
indicators.question: How large was tax revenue relative to GDP in the historical series?
indicators.subtitle_note: World Bank WDI; central-government coverage; latest archived observation 2019

indicators.title: Central-government expenses
indicators.question: How did central-government expenses change in the historical series?
indicators.subtitle_note: World Bank WDI; central-government coverage; latest archived observation 2019

indicators.title: Government interest payments
indicators.question: How much central-government expense was absorbed by interest payments?
indicators.subtitle_note: World Bank WDI; percent of central-government expense; latest archived observation 2019
